$schema.description: Path to this schema file. Enables editor validation and autocomplete.

target.description: Build target platform. VS Code builds to out/wycats/; Claude Code builds to out/claude-code/; Codex builds to out/codex/; Pi builds to out/pi/.

fast.description: High-capability model for agents that need strong reasoning (recon, recon-worker). Examples: 'Claude Opus 4.6 Fast (vercel)', 'opus', null (platform default).

balanced.description: Mid-tier model role available to agent definitions. Examples: 'Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (vercel)', 'sonnet', null (platform default).

auxiliary.description: Model for delegated editorial reading (editorial-reader). Examples: 'GPT 5.4 (vercel)', 'haiku', null (platform default).

models.description: Maps authored model roles to provider model names. Null or an omitted role uses the host default.

thinkingLevels.description: Optional target-specific thinking levels keyed by abstract model role. Pi projects these into pi-subagents agent profiles.

core.description: Base tools available to most agents (search, read, etc.).

communication.description: Messages to existing agents, including continuation where supported, without granting new-agent creation. Omitted mappings provide no tools for this group.

edit.description: File editing tools for agents whose assignments include changing artifacts.

terminal.description: Full terminal access (run, await, kill, get output).

terminal-minimal.description: Limited terminal access (run and get output only).

tasks.description: VS Code task creation and execution.

toolGroups.description: Named groups of tool identifiers. Agent source files reference group names, and the build expands them to concrete tool lists. Names that don't match a group key pass through as literals, except communication, which contributes no tools when omitted.

hookMatchers.description: Claude Code hook matcher strings keyed by neutral hook tool name. Used when building consolidated hooks.json.

terminal.description: Matcher for terminal hooks, e.g. Bash.

edit.description: Matcher for edit hooks, e.g. Write|Edit|MultiEdit.

title: Plugin Config
description: Configuration for building the agent plugin. Maps abstract role names to concrete model strings and tool identifiers for your environment.
